headers.name: eagleid
headers.source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cdn/support/is-my-cdn-in-effect (EagleID is an Alibaba Cloud CDN-specific response header, whose presence means the request reached an Alibaba Cloud CDN node) and https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cdn/user-guide/create-a-custom-http-response-header (EagleId is a system-reserved header that cannot be deleted or modified), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.alibabacloud.com and www.aliyun.com (ESA), www.163.com, www.sina.com.cn, www.douyin.com, www.lazada.com, www.miravia.es and www.taobao.com (CDN)

headers.name: ali-swift-global-savetime
headers.source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cdn/support/is-my-cdn-in-effect (a Unix timestamp of when the resource was first cached on the CDN node, mainly returned by international nodes), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.163.com, www.sina.com.cn, www.lazada.com, www.miravia.es and www.taobao.com

headers.name: x-swift-savetime
headers.source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cdn/support/is-my-cdn-in-effect (the GMT time the resource was first cached on the node), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.163.com, www.sina.com.cn, www.lazada.com, www.miravia.es and www.taobao.com

headers.name: x-swift-cachetime
headers.source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cdn/support/is-my-cdn-in-effect (0 means the response cannot be cached), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.163.com, www.sina.com.cn, www.lazada.com, www.miravia.es and www.taobao.com

cookies.name: acw_tc
cookies.source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/edge-security-acceleration/esa/support/http-header (ESA inserts by default a cookie prefixed acw_tc or cdn_sec_tc to identify client sessions) and https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/waf/web-application-firewall-3-0/web-application-firewall-3-0-security-compliance-instructions (WAF inserts the acw_tc cookie into the response by default with HTTP flood and scan protection), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.alibabacloud.com and www.aliyun.com, set by the ESA edge

cookies.name: cdn_sec_tc
cookies.source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/edge-security-acceleration/esa/support/http-header (ESA inserts by default a cookie prefixed acw_tc or cdn_sec_tc to identify client sessions), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.alibabacloud.com and www.aliyun.com, set by the ESA edge

cookies.name: acw_sec*
cookies.source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/edge-security-acceleration/esa/support/http-header (when a request triggers an ESA WAF JavaScript or CAPTCHA challenge, ESA also inserts a cookie prefixed acw_sec that records that the client passed it)

cookies.name: acw_sc__v2
cookies.source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/waf/web-application-firewall-3-0/web-application-firewall-3-0-security-compliance-instructions (after a JS challenge, WAF inserts the acw_sc__v2 cookie to mark the client as verified)

cookies.name: acw_sc__v3
cookies.source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/waf/web-application-firewall-3-0/web-application-firewall-3-0-security-compliance-instructions (after a slider CAPTCHA, WAF inserts the acw_sc__v3 cookie to mark the client as verified)
